content.paragraph: It's made up of skilling, jobs, market linkages, credit, healthcare, and social security. If one rung breaks — a missing skill, a health emergency, a business setback — the whole ladder becomes impossible to climb. Samhita builds it back, rung by rung.

content.quote:
We have proven that when the ladder is strong,


India climbs.

cards.title: For CSR Clients
cards.description: CSR that is impact driven, compliant, cost-efficient, and catalytic. We co-create strategies with you that align with your priorities and geographies.

cards.title: For Foundations
cards.description: We turn your impact vision into action. From bold new ideas to scaling what works, we bring sharp strategy and delivery on the ground.

cards.title: For Government
cards.description: The Government is the main engine of development, and we strengthen its ability to deliver — from local to state to central programs.

cards.title: For Financial Institutions
cards.description: Reach the right customers, faster and smarter. We connect you to creditworthy borrowers with minimal risk.

content.description: We work across the ecosystem with philanthropic organisations, grassroots institutions, financial institutions, government bodies, and private sector partners.

accordions.title: Philanthropic Organisations, CSR Partners & HNIs
accordions.description: We have worked with 15+ philanthropic funders to design and execute Catalytic Finance initiatives — unlocking up to ₹30 for citizens for every ₹1 of philanthropic funding, with 70–100% growth in incomes.

accordions.title: Government & Public Sector Organisations
accordions.description: Partnerships with large-scale government organisations enable us to scale rapidly — including the Common Service Centres network (5.5 lakh+ centres), Sector Skill Councils, and CGTMSE.
accordions.image_alt: ONDC and government digital infrastructure partners.

accordions.title: Banks, NBFCs & Financial Institutions
accordions.description: Most banks want to lend to small business owners and farmers but don't, because they see the risk as too high. We also work with fintech partners so citizens can save and invest from as little as ₹100 a day.

accordions.title: Private Sector Partnerships
accordions.description: We co-create solutions with companies to support the farmers, micro-entrepreneurs, vendors, and gig workers behind their supply chains and products.

accordions.title: Grassroots & Community Partners
accordions.description: 18 grassroots partner organisations across multiple states, building capacity to deliver affordable livelihood solutions in their communities.

content.description: Three programs pushing beyond our core livelihood work into health, enterprise, and urban resilience.

cards.title: Samyak
cards.description: Strengthening urban health systems to bridge inequities for the urban poor in small cities.

cards.title: OneTAC
cards.description: Building India's first digital backbone for tourism, arts, and culture to empower entrepreneurs.

cards.title: Centre for Public Mental Health
cards.description: Scaling mental health solutions to build India's pathway to a zero-burden future for mental health.
